units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	The Successor wriggles. "A scion of Chydiyi plans to marry one of Myurej! T'was announced t'day, early in the morn! units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Prelude Wedding|	The Successor wriggles, a little uncomfortably. "A scion of Chydiyi announced their plan to marry one of Myurej's. T'was announced today, along with a message of their sympathy for Kaatrij. A little convenient, methinks. Chydiyi and Myurej t'were already each other's darlings, and now they'll be closer still..." As they trail off, they spot someone in the crowd and excuse themselves before slithering away. As you go about your business, you are interrupted a few more times to see if you've "heard the news." While quite a few of the Successors here are relatively excited about the upcoming noble wedding, many take on a more suspicious tone. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts QSI 3|	'Tis good of thee, captain, that thou soughtest me out upon learning of this recent incident. Thine instincts do thee justice. Nonetheless, I've naught to give thee. The matter underway is of Kaatrij and does not pertain to thee nor the other Houses. If well thou regardest this House, keep clear of this. Enjoy our fruitful world, assist our grateful citizens, be regaled by what gifts we yet may give. Do not pry. This I beseech you, for our sake and for thine: do not be tempted by our secrets' jaws.|227|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|You set the <ship> on one of the landing terraces of the planet's equatorial trench, near a location that Saajret indicates. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 7a|	The two of you make your way through the abandoned streets. units.id: conversation:saajret returns|	They continue, the color continuing to sparkle on their skin. "Beautiful beasts, aren't they? Truly aspirational; adept at camouflage, hiding themselves beyond all but the most scrutinizing gaze before closing in on their quarry. In the early days of Kaatrij, when the Kijran were still new, some particularly well-cloaked ones slipped into a weather-control tower. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Cloak Prompt|	Some things are just the same, though, like the news display that you realize is right above you as it lets out a particularly noticeable warble. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"I see," it says. "You have uncovered one of our great secrets of the galaxy. You were right to think that the world you speak of is ours. After what that foolish species did to themselves, we the Quarg could not bear to leave them unobserved. But we dared not do so unshrouded, lest we once again rouse them to the heights of envy - so we built no ringworld, no stations, no open worlds. Only a little... watching post, to keep our gaze over the Myiara."|938|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"What they discovered was not what the Drak had, nor the beauty that the Korath, despite all their warring, had wrought. It was a new and dangerous thing, and while it let them explore with new freedom, in the years that followed, its mark became clear. It rent wounds among the stars, tore apart the paths between them, led their ships away to nowhere, and turned their verdant worlds to ash."|949|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"They were then upon the precipice of a great change. Their long-wrought divisions were melding; they had turned away from the gruesome vagaries of war, and were moved to explore and preserve the arts of others. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 9|	"What troubles this one most, though," says the Quarg, "is that this watching post of ours was laid bare to see at all. We made ourselves rancid to the Myiara for their own good, stole away their precious creations, worked with those of them who would help us to tear down so much of what they had built, sealed them away - all so they would not have the means to recreate their folly in a later age. That this deception of ours has come to light may drive them even further from what they were, undo even the meager gains they have wrought in their exile. For all their wrong, that would still be a cause for lament."|970|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 10|You once again descend to the dusty moon, though this time with the authorization to pass through the blockade. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 11|	The archive proves to be relatively modest by Successor standards; most of the engineering effort seems to have gone into armor rather than lush adornment. units.raw: log "People" "Resja" "Resja was a noted Myiaran engineer and shipwright who worked soon before the collapse of the empire of the Myiaran Predecessors, circa 1600. units.id: mission:Successors: Saajret Remarks|As the stygian fog of the Tangled Shroud fades away to reveal normal space, Saajret makes a small noise of excitement, their skin dancing with bright hues. "So long it's been," they say, "since one of ours has seen beyond the horizon of our folly. I confess I wonder what the rest of the galaxy has become after fifteen hundred years of solitude." They shake their head, the regions of color splashing like water. "Yet our task remains. Perhaps in some future time..."|1496|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	The elevator takes the four of you down for several minutes; every once in a while, a window to the outside shows individual flashes of the sun setting as the station continues in its orbit. It finally stops on a platform overlooking a vast, dizzyingly-tall space, where pillars rise up for what seems like kilometers below you and terminate kilometers above. Myriad cargo containers are attached to their sides, and between them rest eight gleaming starships. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts 16|	You all return to the elevator and it once again begins to plunge you deeper into the citadel. You start to feel something prickling in your ear, but it is gone as soon as it began. The views of outside stop and the elevator shaft seems to grow darker and redder as the four of you travel deeper. Eventually it reaches another platform, but the door of the elevator refuses to open. Saajret enters some commands on the elevator controls, and the reason is revealed: as the elevator's door blushes transparent, you can see the corridor behind it has been perforated and torn open from outside. In the distance you can see a blast door leading into an armored, spherical construction, but that too has been blasted apart.|1591|0

Saajret enters some commands on the elevator controls, and the reason is revealed: as the elevator's door blushes transparent, you can see the corridor behind it has been perforated and torn open from outside. In the distance you can see a blast door leading into an armored, spherical construction, but that too has been blasted apart.
units.raw: `	You all return to the elevator and it once again begins to plunge you deeper into the citadel. You start to feel something prickling in your ear, but it is gone as soon as it began. Eventually it reaches another platform, but the door of the elevator refuses to open. units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Though it's a few minutes before your data-sphere missive is answered, Saajret soon invites you to join them in a nearby town, which proves to be only a half-hour away by spaceport shuttle. It is built into an amphitheatre-shaped cutout of a seaside cliff, terraced homes and shops emerging from the rock with their curious flowing Kaatrij architecture. Many share the sail-like projections of the main spaceport, some decorated with iridescent patterns that shimmer as the wind tosses them.|2160|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Saajret meets you at the regional spaceport, explaining that you caught them on a day off. They lead you through the town to one of the more elegant homes. It's shaped like a series of concentric semicircles, and they invite you into the outermost one, what you might call a receiving area with benches and indoor gardens. Small robots slither over the floors, attending to dust and water.|2161|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	Something about hearing their name in this context seems to strike a discordant chord within Saajret. All at once confusion and anger and sorrow flit over them before they tense and their skin becomes a steely gray. They say nothing more on the matter, instead striking up a conversation about your recent experiences and never slowing. After an hour or so of catching up, they've finally had enough and let the conversation die.|2166|0

units.id: mission:Successors: Ghosts Reincarnation|	As you leave, Saajret turns to you a final time.
